fields.label: Cloud Provider
fields.description: Account this network belongs to. Blank for a bare-metal placeholder. Set once — every id below belongs to this account.

fields.label: Region
fields.description: A VPC cannot span regions, so this is set once. Machines linked to this Network inherit it. Bare-metal placeholder: pick a Region with no Cloud Provider.

fields.label: Availability Zone
fields.description: The subnet's AZ, e.g. ap-south-1a. Create Network picks the region's first available one and records it here.

fields.label: Machine Image
fields.description: Default AMI id for Machines launched into this Network, e.g. ami-0abc123. AMI ids are region-scoped, so this lives here rather than on Cloud Provider — one per region, not one per account. A Machine's own Machine Image overrides this.

fields.label: CIDR Block
fields.description: VPC CIDR. Assigned on save to the next unused /16 in 10.0.0.0/8 — every Network gets a distinct range, so VPCs can be peered later without an overlap.

fields.label: Subnet CIDR Block
fields.description: The one public subnet Grove launches into: the first /24 of the VPC CIDR, assigned on save.

fields.label: Subnet ID
fields.description: The subnet Machines in this Network launch into. Filled in by Create Network.

fields.label: Internet Gateway ID
fields.description: Filled in by Create Network. Informational.

fields.label: Route Table ID
fields.description: Filled in by Create Network. Informational — the VPC's own default route table, given a 0.0.0.0/0 route to the Internet Gateway.

fields.label: Proxy Security Group IDs
fields.description: For a Proxy Server box: 22, 80 and 443 open to 0.0.0.0/0. Filled in by Create Security Groups.

fields.label: Inference Security Group IDs
fields.description: For an Inference Server box: 22 open to 0.0.0.0/0, and 443 — the engine proxy, fronting every deployment and both exporters — open only to the proxy fleet and the metrics agents. Filled in by Create Security Groups; the 443 sources are kept current by Sync Ingress Rules.
